# Tic Tac Tooth Pediatric Dentistry

> A kid-friendly pediatric dental practice in Naperville, IL offering comprehensive children's dental care from board-certified specialists.

Tic Tac Tooth Pediatric Dentistry is a specialized pediatric dental practice located in Naperville, Illinois, featuring multiple board-certified pediatric dentists including Dr. Asim Awan, Dr. Jiana Panos, Dr. Sarah Specht, and Dr. Ji-Hoon Min. The practice provides preventive, cosmetic, and emergency dental services for children with an emphasis on creating a welcoming, kid-friendly environment.
